<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="right">(h)</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top" >&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">For additional information regarding our use of Further Adjusted EBITDA and Structuring Adjusted EBITDA and limitations on their usefulness as analytical tools, see &#147;Explanation of Certain Financial Matters.&#148;
In addition, the items in the calculation of Structuring Adjusted EBITDA below regarding the future financial impact of customer purchase commitments and capital expenditure projects are forward-looking statements (the &#147;outlook
adjustments&#148;). These outlook adjustments are subject to various risks and uncertainties, many of which are beyond our control. For example, we have estimated the future financial impact of certain customer purchase commitments net of their
expected costs. Actual costs may exceed our projections, including as a result of increased aluminum, energy, labor or other operating costs or other factors, which could limit the benefits we expect to realize from these customer purchase
commitments. We have also made certain assumptions regarding customer purchase commitments based on our historical experience with such customers and industry practice. Some of these commitments are not subject to contractual arrangements, and to
the extent these customers seek to reduce or delay their commitments, we will not realize the benefits expected from these commitments. In addition, certain of the anticipated benefits contained in or implied by the outlook adjustments are not
expected to be realized until the successful ramp up of ABS production at our Lewisport facility and of certain aerospace production at our Koblenz and Zhenjiang facilities. As a result, we expect to realize only a portion of the anticipated
benefits contained in or implied by these outlook adjustments during the year ending December&nbsp;31, 2018, as ramp up at these facilities is expected to occur over the next several years. See &#147;Forward Looking Statements&#148; and &#147;Risk
Factors&#151;We may be unable to achieve some or all of the benefits that we expect to realize as a result of certain customer purchase commitments and capital expenditure projects&#148; herein and &#147;Risk Factors&#148; and
&#147;Management&#146;s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operation&#151;Outlook&#148; (excluding &#147;&#151;2018 Outlook&#148;) in the 2017 <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-K</FONT> for a discussion of additional
risks, uncertainties and other factors that may cause our actual results to differ materially from those expressed in our outlook adjustments. </TD></TR></TABLE>

Transactions. Accordingly, we do not intend to update or provide these financial measures on an ongoing basis. </P>

<TD WIDTH="3%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">Represents the estimated Adjusted EBITDA impact of lost volumes related to the planned hot mill outage at our Lewisport facility, which occurred during the third quarter of 2017. The planned hot mill outage was related
to the upgrades we have made to our existing asset base at our Lewisport facility in connection with the North America ABS Project. During the outage, we upgraded our ingot scalper and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-heating</FONT> furnace
capabilities, widened our hot mill and installed <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">state-of-the-art</FONT></FONT></FONT> mill controls. This necessary outage took approximately 60 days
(together with the commissioning of the hot mill after the outage, effectively 75 days) to complete and impacted our ability to produce and ship products to customers. We estimate that we missed 100&nbsp;million pounds (45 kilotons) of customer
shipments during the outage. </TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:8pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">Represents the estimated Adjusted EBITDA impact of lost volumes related to blocking the capacity of the CALP at our Duffel facility to supply ABS to our Lewisport facility in connection with customer qualifications
related to the North America ABS Project, which impacted our ability to produce and ship products to customers during 2017. </TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:8pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="3%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">Represents the estimated Adjusted EBITDA impact of lost volumes related to the allocation of equipment run time at our Koblenz and Zhenjiang facilities for the development and qualification of new wingskin products,
which impacted our ability to produce and ship products to customers during 2017. We expect to introduce wingskin production at our Koblenz facility in the second half of 2018 and at our Zhenjiang facility in early 2019. </TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:8pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="3%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iv)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">Represents the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">mid-point</FONT> of the estimated future Adjusted EBITDA impact of expected increases in shipments of automotive products from our Lewisport facility related to certain
customer purchase commitments, net of their expected cost. </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:7%; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Aluminum ABS products are expected to generate more than twice the
commercial margin per ton of the standard distribution sheet currently produced at the Lewisport facility. Over the next several years, this is expected to have a meaningful impact on our profitability. Based on existing long-term customer
commitments, which account for approximately 60% of our ABS capacity through 2025 and include significant &#147;take or pay&#148; obligations, we believe the segment income and Adjusted EBITDA impact of the North America ABS Project could range from
$65&nbsp;million to $75&nbsp;million in 2019. We expect the full ramp up of ABS shipments from our combined CALP capacity to occur over the next four years. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:7%; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Estimates of the future Adjusted EBITDA impact from certain existing commitments have been determined using a range of expected customer
nominated volumes based on existing customer commitments and applying an appropriate estimate of average profitability per ton. For the expected automotive volumes, to determine an estimate of average North America segment income and Adjusted EBITDA
per ton, we used the range of rolling margins per ton included in the pricing terms of our existing customer arrangements. These rolling margins were then compared to Lewisport&#146;s average rolling margin per ton in 2017. Profitability per ton
also reflects an estimate of incremental cash conversion costs. </P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:8pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="3%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(v)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">Represents the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">mid-point</FONT> of the estimated future Adjusted EBITDA impact of expected increases in shipments of aerospace products related to certain customer purchase commitments,
net of their expected cost. </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:7%; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">During 2016 and 2017, several of our long-term contracts with major aircraft OEMs were
successfully renewed. Each contract was renewed with a higher share of the OEM&#146;s aerospace business and with a higher value-added mix of products and alloys. Based upon expected aircraft build rates, these new contracts and products are
expected to increase Adjusted EBITDA by $20&nbsp;million to $30&nbsp;million annually, beginning in 2019. The full annual benefit of these contracts is not expected to be realized until 2022. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:7%; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Estimates of the future Adjusted EBITDA impact from certain existing commitments have been determined using a range of expected customer
nominated volumes based on existing customer commitments and applying an appropriate estimate of average profitability per ton. For the expected aerospace volumes, the estimate of average Europe and Asia Pacific segment income and Adjusted EBITDA
per ton was determined using the 2017 Company-wide average Adjusted EBITDA per ton for aerospace products plus an estimate of profitability benefits from fixed cost leverage, which was based on our 2017 aerospace fixed cost absorption and adjusted
for the higher production volumes expected to be realized in the future under certain aerospace contracts. </P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:8pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="right">(i)</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top" >&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">The as adjusted ratio of Further Adjusted EBITDA and Structuring Adjusted EBITDA to cash interest expense for the twelve months ended March&nbsp;31, 2018 gives effect to the consummation of the Refinancing Transactions
as if they had occurred on April&nbsp;1, 2017 and reflects interest expense related to the private financing transaction as well as borrowings under the New First Lien Term Loan Facility, based on an estimated weighted-average blended rate of
approximately 7.4%. The interest rates related to the private financing transaction and the New First Lien Term Loan Facility are based on assumptions of the rates to be effective upon closing of the Refinancing Transactions. </TD></TR></TABLE>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:8pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="2%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="right">(j)</TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top" >&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">The as adjusted ratios of debt and net debt, as described in (g)&nbsp;above, to Further Adjusted EBITDA and Structuring Adjusted EBITDA as of March&nbsp;31, 2018 give effect to the consummation of the Refinancing
Transactions as if they had occurred on April&nbsp;1, 2017. </TD></TR></TABLE>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>RISK FACTORS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>We may be unable to achieve some or all of the benefits that we expect to realize as a result of certain customer purchase commitments and capital
expenditure projects. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We present Structuring Adjusted EBITDA, a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> financial measure and
forward-looking statement herein. Structuring Adjusted EBITDA is being provided for illustrative purposes only in connection with the Refinancing Transactions. Accordingly, we do not intend to update or provide this financial measure on an ongoing
basis. The items in the calculation of Structuring Adjusted EBITDA regarding the future financial impact of customer purchase commitments and capital expenditure projects are forward-looking statements (the &#147;outlook adjustments&#148;). These
outlook adjustments are subject to various risks and uncertainties, many of which are beyond our control. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We prepared the outlook
adjustments based upon available information and assumptions and estimates that we believe are reasonable. Accordingly, the outlook adjustments may not be indicative of our future operating or financial performance. Our actual results of operations
may vary materially from our presentation of Structuring Adjusted EBITDA. In particular, we cannot assure you that the expected increases in shipments of automotive and aerospace products reflected in Structuring Adjusted EBITDA will be realized on
our expected timing or at all or that our estimates and assumptions will prove to be accurate. For example, we have estimated the future financial impact of certain customer purchase commitments net of their expected costs. Actual costs may exceed
our projections, including as a result of increased aluminum, energy, labor or other operating costs or other factors, which could limit the benefits we expect to realize from these customer purchase commitments. We have also made certain
assumptions regarding customer purchase commitments based on our historical experience with such customers and industry practice. Some of these commitments are not subject to contractual arrangements, and to the extent these customers seek to reduce
or delay their commitments, we will not realize the benefits expected from these commitments. In addition, certain of the anticipated benefits contained in or implied by the outlook adjustments are not expected to be realized until the successful
ramp up of ABS production at our Lewisport facility and of certain aerospace production at our Koblenz and Zhenjiang facilities. As a result, we expect to realize only a portion of the anticipated benefits contained in or implied by these outlook
adjustments during the year ending December&nbsp;31, 2018, as ramp up at these facilities is expected to occur over the next several years. In addition, our actual results of operations may vary as a result of future currency exchange rate
fluctuation. See &#147;Forward Looking Statements&#148; herein and &#147;Risk Factors&#148; and &#147;Management&#146;s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operation&#151;Outlook&#148; (excluding &#147;&#151;2018
Outlook&#148;) in the 2017 <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-K</FONT> for a discussion of additional risks, uncertainties and other factors that may cause our actual results to differ materially from those expressed in our outlook adjustments.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Our estimates for the quarter ending June&nbsp;30, 2018 reflect certain management estimates and assumptions. Furthermore, our actual results for the
quarter ending June&nbsp;30, 2018 may differ from these estimates. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The quarter ending June&nbsp;30, 2018 is not yet complete and our
financial results for the quarter ending June&nbsp;30, 2018 are not available yet. Although we do not typically provide quantitative or intra-quarter guidance, we present certain estimates for the quarter ending June&nbsp;30, 2018, which are
forward-looking statements herein. These estimates reflect management&#146;s best estimates based upon currently available information and certain assumptions we believe to be reasonable, including estimates of tons to be produced and sold during
the quarter, commercial margin to be generated from tons sold and conversion costs to be incurred in production, which are also forward-looking statements. Any one or more of the assumptions may be incorrect and future results may be different from
the estimates and the differences may be materially less favorable. The estimates and assumptions have not been reviewed or verified by any third party, including our independent auditors. </P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Because we have not yet completed our second quarter of 2018, the estimates and assumptions are
based on events that have not yet occurred and are subject to all of the risks and uncertainties, many of which are not within our control, inherent in making projections and may be revised as a result of management&#146;s further review. The
estimates should not be relied upon as fact or as an accurate representation of future results, and the information that is presented as a range of results is not intended to represent that actual results could not fall outside of the suggested
ranges. In particular, the estimates are not a comprehensive statement of our financial results for the quarter ending June&nbsp;30, 2018, and our actual results may differ materially from the estimates due to developments that may arise between now
and the time our second quarter is completed, as well as the time the closing procedures for the fiscal quarter are completed. There can be no assurance that the estimates will be realized in the amounts or during the time period expected, or at
all, and our results for the quarter ending June&nbsp;30, 2018 or any future period may vary materially from the estimates, including as a result of unexpected issues in our business and operations. For example, the estimates assume that no
unexpected risks materialize during the forecasted period, which could include significant business, economic, financial, regulatory, competitive or market risks, any of which could result in materially different results than the estimates.
Accordingly, you should not place undue reliance on the estimates. See &#147;Forward Looking Statements&#148; herein and &#147;Risk Factors&#148; and &#147;Management&#146;s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of
Operation&#151;Outlook&#148; (excluding &#147;&#151;2018 Outlook&#148;) in the 2017 <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-K</FONT> for a discussion of additional risks, uncertainties and other factors that may cause our actual results to differ
materially from the estimates. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In addition, the estimated amount of Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter ending June&nbsp;30, 2018 presented
herein is a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-GAAP</FONT> Measure and investors will not have the ability to compare such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-GAAP</FONT> Measure against the most comparable GAAP measure. As a result, the
limitations of such measure are even more pronounced. See &#147;Explanation of Certain Financial Matters&#148; herein. </P>
